Therefore f''(x) > 0 on 1 < x < 2.

From the text, focus only on the sign of f''(x) over this interval. Use the bridge that f''(x) measures the rate of change of f'(x). Since the slopes of f(x) are increasing across 1 < x < 2, f'(x) is increasing, so f''(x) is positive. Thus f''(x) > 0.
